quality_assessment: Page covers core output formatting well but is missing several important output features and lacks visual enhancements for better readability

issues.description: Missing documentation for byte offset (-b/--byte-offset) feature
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section documenting byte offset flag: 'Print the 0-based byte offset within the input file before each matching line'

issues.description: Missing documentation for only matching part (-o/--only-matching) feature
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section documenting only-matching flag: 'Print only the matched parts of a line, each on a separate line'

issues.description: Missing documentation for count mode (-c/--count and --count-matches) features
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section documenting count flags: '-c shows match counts per file, --count-matches shows total match count across files'

issues.description: Missing documentation for vimgrep format (--vimgrep) and files-only modes
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section documenting --vimgrep (Vim quickfix format), -l/--files-with-matches (file names only), --files-without-match

issues.description: Missing documentation for JSON output format (--json)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section documenting JSON output for machine-readable results: '--json flag produces JSON Lines format with structured match data'

issues.description: Missing documentation for file path display control (--with-filename, --no-filename, -I)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining when file paths are shown and how to control this behavior
Add section documenting result sorting: '--sort path|modified|accessed|created and --sortr for reverse. Note: disables parallelism'

issues.description: Color documentation doesn't mention all color modes available
issues.should_be: --color flag supports: never, auto, always, ansi. Default is 'auto' which detects TTY
issues.fix_suggestion: Expand color section to explain what each mode does and when to use them (e.g., 'always' for piping to 'less -R')

issues.description: Page lacks visual enhancements that would improve readability
issues.fix_suggestion: Add MkDocs Material features: admonitions for tips (e.g., '!!! tip "Common Usage"'), tabs for different output format comparisons, code annotations for complex examples
